stratagems.name: Ancestral Grudge
stratagems.when: Any phase, just after an enemy unit targets a friendly LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit.
stratagems.effect: Place a Judgement token on that enemy unit. While an enemy unit has any Judgement tokens, worsen the saving throw of models in that unit by 1 for each Judgement token (to a min of 6+).

stratagems.name: Efficient Harvest
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack against a unit with one or more Judgement tokens, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

stratagems.name: Iron Will
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One LEAGUES OF VOTANN unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack (min 1).
